name: Pareto Chart
excerpt: Pareto Chart is a bar chart with a cumulative percentage line, used to identify major causes of problems.
notes: The Pareto Chart is based on the 80/20 rule, suggesting that 80% of problems come from 20% of causes. It helps prioritize issues in project management.
context_summary: - A bar chart with a cumulative percentage line.
- Used to identify major causes of problems.
